name: Slime Well
description:
About This Game

Explore a long-abandoned land and discover the secrets hidden within. Along the way, you’ll learn a variety of new abilities and use them to unravel one mystery after another. In the end, what will you choose: endless solitude, or eternal slumber?

  • Featuring exquisite cartoon pixel art and visual effects.

  • No violence, no death — everything is focused on puzzles and exploration.

  • Over 100 meticulously designed levels, packed with creative puzzles and collectibles scattered across the world.

  • Rich environmental interactions for an immersive exploration experience.

  • Secrets and easter eggs hidden throughout the game.

  • And of course… chocolate is delicious, meow.
short_desc: Slime Well is a Metroidvania-style puzzle game where players take control of a slime, skillfully using its abilities to solve puzzles, explore, and ultimately uncover the truth of this world.
